user.title: SolarEdge ONE (v2 API)
user.description: Enter your site ID and OAuth app credentials. Next you will log in to SolarEdge in your browser and paste the address you are redirected to. (HA's built-in OAuth flow can't be used because SolarEdge does not return the OAuth state parameter.)

data_description.site_id: Shown in the SolarEdge monitoring portal.
data_description.client_id: OAuth client ID from your app in the SolarEdge developer portal.
data_description.client_secret: OAuth client secret from the same app.
data_description.refresh_token: Leave empty to log in through the browser. Only fill in if you already have one.
data_description.authorize_url: From SolarEdge's homeowner and self-access guide.
data_description.redirect_uri: Exactly the redirect URI registered with your OAuth app.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate SolarEdge
reauth_confirm.description: SolarEdge rejected the stored token. Get a new refresh token (see the project README) and paste it here.

data_description.refresh_token: Obtained once outside Home Assistant (see the project README). SolarEdge issues a new one on every refresh and the integration stores it automatically.

reconfigure.title: Update SolarEdge credentials
reconfigure.description: Replace the OAuth credentials for this site. The site ID cannot be changed here; add a new entry for a different site.

data_description.client_id: OAuth client ID from your app in the SolarEdge developer portal.
data_description.client_secret: OAuth client secret from the same app.
data_description.refresh_token: Obtained once outside Home Assistant (see the project README). SolarEdge issues a new one on every refresh and the integration stores it automatically.

authorize.title: Approve access
authorize.description:
Open this link, log in and approve access: {url}

You will be redirected to your redirect URI (the page may fail to load). Copy the full address from the browser's address bar and paste it below.

abort.already_configured: This SolarEdge site is already configured

error.exchange_failed: SolarEdge rejected the code. Codes expire quickly; open the link again and paste the new address.

init.title: SolarEdge polling
init.description: The free API tier allows about 2,000 calls a month. Every 30 minutes all day is about 1,440; every 15 minutes all day (about 2,900) exceeds it unless polling is limited to daylight.

data.daylight_only: Only poll while the sun is up

data_description.scan_interval: Minutes between API calls (15-240). Data has 15-minute resolution, so polling faster gains nothing.
data_description.daylight_only: Skip API calls between sunset and sunrise to save credits. Today's totals are kept overnight and reset at midnight.
